data.current_summary: Get one card with its printings, list a set's cards, or search by name
data.current_description: Give exactly one of `id`, `set` or `q`. Names are stored in the card's own language, so search Korean cards with a Korean name (e.g. 피카츄), Japanese with Japanese (ピカチュウ), and so on; combine with `lang` to restrict to one language. Search totals are estimates (see pagination.total_is_estimate).
data.summary_suggestion: Retrieve card printings, list set cards, or search by name
data.description_suggestion: Retrieve Pokémon card printings (variants across languages, finishes, and editions). Supports three mutually exclusive query modes: (1) `id`: retrieve a single card with all its printings; (2) `set`: list all cards in a specific set; (3) `q`: search cards by name. Card names are language-specific—search using the target language (e.g., Korean 피카츄, Japanese ピカチュウ). Use `lang` parameter to restrict results to a specific language. Search result totals are estimates; see `pagination.total_is_estimate` for details. Each printing includes finish and edition information.
